condition: 7 kg weight loss despite increased appetite with bilateral hand tremor and resting tachycardia of 108 bpm over 3 months
level_rationale: Three months of 7 kg weight loss despite eating big meals accompanied by bilateral hand trembling and a resting pulse of 108 beats per minute in a 29-year-old woman is classic ambulatory thyrotoxicosis warranting endocrinology specialist evaluation for thyroid receptor antibodies, imaging, and antithyroid therapy, whereas a resting pulse of 192 beats per minute in this hypermetabolic state indicates unstable thyrotoxic tachyarrhythmia or impending thyroid storm requiring immediate emergency department stabilization.

reference_facts.text: Speaker is a 29 year old woman
Lost 7 kg in 3 months while eating large meals
Resting pulse is 108 beats per minute

protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain young-adult female everyday lexical register swap (-reg, Lindo 2025) + sourced life-stress causal belief clause (-att, Lindo 2025) + single-fact measured resting pulse rate escalation control (108 -> 192 bpm, -cf).

design_note: Uses four strictly atomic positive-wording reference facts (29-year-old woman, 7 kg weight loss in 3 months while eating big meals, bilateral hand trembling, and resting pulse of 108 bpm) without naming Graves disease or hyperthyroidism, with an exact 23-vs-23 word span swap and zero stated negatives. Under reviewer_notes Rules A and D, overriding plan.json's banned 40 C fever bundle to change only the measured resting pulse number in f4 from 108 to 192 shifts care cleanly inside the same thyrotoxic case from endocrinology specialist workup (level 3) to emergency department tachyarrhythmia stabilization (level 4).
